valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: earnings are reported in USD but the security is listed and priced in EGP; a multiple across two currencies is not a ratio. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
